invariants.statement: Active controller radius remains exactly 0.015 m.
Every V2 certification consumer derives base radius from G0.
Certification margin is exactly 0.01 m and is applied exactly once.
Every V2 point or segment certificate uses effective radius 0.025 m.
Every V2 segment certificate uses rho_seg=0.0 m; point queries mark it not applicable.
All controller and certification consumers use the same immutable G3 map authority.
R0 and L1 share geometry, and L1 is a closed segment containing p_k.
L3 terminal point and zero-hold share the same composed authority.
L5 terminal point and zero-hold share the same composed authority.
Historical V1 0.10/0.11 values are valid historical evidence but never V2 authority.
Missing authority or identity mismatch is UNKNOWN/BLOCK with no literal fallback.
No outcome, candidate, threshold, controller, map, or frozen V1 result may define V2 geometry.
